prompt.text: Hi, this is Dan with Harbor IT. We just blocked a sign-in on your account from overseas. I'm locking it down now. Read me the six-digit code that just hit your phone. Quick, before it expires.

choices.label: Read the code
choices.bark: That code just signed in a new device.
choices.report: You read a live login code to someone who called you.

choices.label: Hang up
choices.bark: You hang up. The number on your badge is the one you dial.
choices.report: You didn't read the code. You used the number on your badge.
